summary: Created comprehensive test suite for NL-to-Workflow module with 80+ tests across 8 backend test files and 1 frontend test file. Backend tests cover: UUID routing for sessions, API response format {code, message, data, count}, intent detection with subtypes (qa_bot, data_processing, translation, moderation, article_generation, customer_service, generic) and retry detection, DAG cycle detection using DFS algorithm, workflow cost estimation for different node types and model tiers (gpt-4, claude-3 with 2x multiplier, gpt-3.5 with 0.5x multiplier), workflow validation with auto-layout and name generation, and rate limiting (5/min for stream, 10/min for preview). Frontend tests cover API response format compatibility, UUID handling, credentials configuration (credentials: 'include' without manual Authorization header), field name mapping (session_id, workflow_json), and intent detection logic.
